Mira Patel: Quick design pass on the Compliance page — flagged a few small but important nits around wording and accessibility. Filing here before the PM sync. Jonathan Lee: Thanks Mira. Can you paste the screenshots or callouts you mean? I only glanced. Mira Patel: Sure — main points below. I left inline copy suggestions and a couple of keyboard/aria nits. Mira Patel: 1) Region selector label — currently says `Region`. Suggest `Data residency (region)` or just `Data residency` to make intent explicit for compliance teams. Mira Patel: 2) Retention dropdown units — we show `30`, `90`, `365`. Add unit suffixes (`days`, `days`, `days`) and support `30 days` display. People scan for units, not numbers. Ash K.: Strong +1 on explicit units. Also: timezone of retention start? Is that UTC or account timezone? We should call that out in the small help text. Mira Patel: Good catch Ash. Suggested help copy: `Retention windows are measured in UTC from the time the request is stored.` Short and linkable to docs. Samir Desai: Regarding KMS wording — current label `Encryption: KMS` is terse and confusing to non-infra folks. Propose `Encryption key (customer-managed KMS)` with a secondary inline help: `Redwood-managed keys are used if you don't provide one.` Jonathan Lee: I like that. Also, the toggle UI hides the key ID in a dropdown with no copy affordance. That's bad for audit/ops. Mira Patel: UX nit: show truncated key id `rwd-...-9a2b` with a copy icon and an accessible `aria-label="Copy encryption key id"` on the button. Ash K.: Accessibility: color contrast on the warning chip for retention > 365 days is failing contrast test. Use #b04521 instead of the current background, or add a dark outline. Samir Desai: Also keyboard navigation — when opening the region list, focus doesn't land on the first item; first press of down-arrow closes it (focus lost). Repro steps in case: `Tab` to region > `Enter` to open > `ArrowDown` expected to highlight first option but nothing happens. Mira Patel: Thanks. Add `aria-activedescendant` behavior and ensure `role=menu` semantics. Small code hint for devs: Mira Patel: ``` Mira Patel:
    Mira Patel:
  • EU (Frankfurt)
    • Mira Patel:
Mira Patel: ``` Jonathan Lee: Copy wording in Audit Logs: currently `Export` button downloads CSV by default. Some customers expect `Export` to mean push to S3 or webhook. Suggest `Download CSV` (primary) and a small chevron menu for `Export to S3 / Send to webhook`. Samir Desai: Agree. Also change the date-range quick presets from `Last 24` to `Last 24 hours` for clarity. Ash K.: For modal confirm when changing retention to < 30 days, the text is scary and legalese-y. Make it human: `Shorter retention may reduce available logs for investigations. Are you sure you want to keep data for 7 days?` and add inline `Learn more` link. Mira Patel: Good. One more: telemetry checkbox copy currently `Allow Redwood to collect usage data`. Change to `Share anonymized usage data to improve product` and add `Help` tooltip linking to privacy doc. Jonathan Lee: UX-bot test notes: ran axe on the page. Failures: missing form labels on the KMS input, insufficient contrast for inline links, and an ARIA-required attribute on region list missing. I'll attach the axe snippet later. Mira Patel: I'll update the design file with copy changes and mark components needing a11y fixes. @Ash K. can you review the KMS input interaction? I'll queue a follow-up design PR. Ash K.: Will do — will also add copy variants for localization (EN/FR/DE) since the phrasing changes impact translation. Samir Desai: Quick acceptance criteria for eng: 1) Region label updated, 2) retention shows units + help text, 3) KMS key id copy + aria-label, 4) audit logs `Download CSV` + export menu, 5) color contrast fixed, 6) keyboard focus on region options. All tests should include axe baseline. Mira Patel: Great. I'll create the ticket with mocks and link this thread. Thanks all :shipit: ux-bot: Automated note — `axe` snapshot attached to ticket PROD-4478 by Jonathan Lee at 1766202000.
